fusions.name: Carrion Tear
fusions.desc: A weapon strike on a target carrying one of your afflictions that deals 8 damage and uses that affliction up. It makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds, and you heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Circling Vultures
fusions.desc: Wheels down onto every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 26 damage. If it hits, every ally near you strikes 20% harder for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Feeding the Brood
fusions.desc: Restores 15 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Picking the Bones
fusions.desc: Each time you kill something, 20% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
